title: The War of the Worlds
author: H.G. Wells
engineRationale: A concrete, external sci-fi spectacle (Martian tripods, heat-ray, red weed razing Victorian England) — carried by cinematic set-pieces, not internal/abstract states. Flux photoreal cinematic stills (Vox) render this epic scale far better than a flat-vector everyman rig; the narrator is an unnamed observer whose eyes we borrow, so the imagery must be the world, not a character.
